description: This file contains functions for calculating contributions of DataFrame columns to row or column totals, including handling of time-shifted columns, with validation and error handling, used in the context of data post-processing in the Superset project.

methods.name: contribution
methods.description: Calculates cell contributions to row or column totals for numeric columns in a DataFrame, with options for orientation, specific columns, time shifts, renaming, and pre-calculated totals.

methods.name: get_column_groups
methods.description: Groups DataFrame columns based on whether they have associated time shifts, separating them into time-shifted and non-time-shifted groups.

methods.name: calculate_row_contribution
methods.description: Calculates the contribution percentage of specified columns to each row's total and updates the DataFrame in place.
